traffic_forecast_summary: Baseline (post-launch month 1): avg 2.5 QPS across US region, expected traffic growth +40% MoM for first 3 months.
Peak design target: sustain 12 QPS for 10-20 minutes (feature release spikes); single-minute peak up to 20 QPS needs to be handled via autoscale or fallback to hosted).
Concurrency targets: p50 concurrency ~4, p95 concurrency ~9 during peak windows.
Token distribution: 65% short-chat (total tokens <300), 25% medium gen (300-800 tokens), 10% embeddings/rerank small payloads.
Batching expectations: safe batching factor 8-16 for reranking and embeddings, but chat needs lower batching to meet latency SLOs.
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Recommend starting with 2x A100-equivalent GPUs in NA region with autoscale headroom to 4 nodes. KV prefix cache enabled to reduce token compute on repeated prompts. Configure per-route routing: chat pinned to low-latency pool, rerank/embeddings to cost-optimized pool. Suggest initial commit for 200k tokens/day with monthly review.
pricing_notes: Customer prefers committed monthly pricing vs pure on-demand — they'll consider 12-month reserved if Dedicated POC proves throughput/latency. Target blended cost per 1k tokens must be < $0.60 to hit internal unit economics.
